description: Breeze - a Flutter-based comic reader that loads multiple comic sources through plugins.

script: # v3.0.38 replaced the Tauri bundle with an Inno Setup 7 installer, so unpack it instead of
# running it: no silent flags, no registry writes, and the payload is still the same Release\
# layout. innounp keeps the {app} placeholder as a literal directory, hence the hoist step.
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { abort 'innounp could not unpack the Breeze installer.' }
if (-not (Test-Path "$dir\Release\zephyr.exe")) { abort 'Breeze layout changed: Release\zephyr.exe is missing after unpacking.' }

notes: Breeze renders web content through the Microsoft Edge WebView2 runtime (bundled with Windows 11 and most Windows 10 builds). If plugin pages stay blank, install it from https://developer.microsoft.com/microsoft-edge/webview2/
